title: K1 S Flow Blue

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The AGV K1 S Flow Blue is optimized for high-performance street and spirited backroad riding, pairing agile street ergonomics with certified multi-impact protection. Built around a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell weighing 1421g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~88 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.06 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for confident all-day riding.

product_details.description: Aerodynamic shape and racing ventilation for everyday riders.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for Intermediate Oval head shape; medium-to-high profile fit offers slightly more room in the crown compared to legacy K1 models while maintaining a snug chin bar closure; requires specific cheek pads for optimal retention.

technical_analysis: Features 100% 3K Carbon Fiber shell construction developed under AGV Extreme Safety protocol for MotoGP performance paired with Class-1 optical Ultravision shield offering 190° horizontal and 85° vertical field of view. The interior utilizes 360° Adaptive Fit crown structure with 2Dry moisture-wicking Shalimar & Ritmo fabric lining with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the AGV K1 S Flow Blue: combining Italy 🇮🇹 craftsmanship with Class-1 optical Ultravision shield offering 190° horizontal and 85° vertical field of view and 360° Adaptive Fit crown structure with 2Dry moisture-wicking Shalimar & Ritmo fabric lining. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.

introduction: Positioned in AGV's Full Face lineup, the K1 S Flow Blue brings Italian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The AGV K1 S Flow Blue represents AGV's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~88 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the AGV K1 S Flow Blue delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
